**Key finding:** Saint-Tropez has no IT conferences or tech events — it's a 6,000-person resort village with no convention infrastructure. Nearest options: Cannes (~1.5 hrs, Datacloud Global Congress ends today; WAICF annually in Feb), Sophia Antipolis (~2 hrs, ETSI Security in Oct, Azur Tech Summer July 2), and Toulon (~1 hr, French Tech on the Beach July 9 and monthly meetups). The most accessible is Salon VAR TECH in La Farlède (~45 min), a free local fair in the Var department.
